attribute_information.Atmos_CO2: Concentration of atmospheric CO2. Measured daily
attribute_information.G_Method: Growing method of the lettuce in the compartment
attribute_information.Height: Height of lettuce plants. Measured twice a week
attribute_information.Irrig_CO2: Concentration of dissolved CO2 in the nutrient solution. Measured daily
attribute_information.Irrig_EC: Electrical conductivity of nutrient solution left in the irrigation tank. Measured daily
attribute_information.Irrig_Volume: Volume of nutrient solution left in the irrigation tank. Measured daily
attribute_information.Irrig_pH: pH of nutrient solution left in the irrigation tank. Measured daily
attribute_information.LFresh_Weight: Fresh weight of the leaves after harvest
attribute_information.Leaf_Area: Leaf area of the largest leaf after harvest
attribute_information.Leaf_Number: Number of leaves on each lettuce plant. Measured twice a week
attribute_information.Light_Intensity: Light intensity observed by the plants at the canopy level. Measured after transplating and before harvest.
attribute_information.Location: Location of plant in the row or column
attribute_information.Post_Irrig_CO2: Concentration of dissolved CO2 in the nutrient solution immediately after it has interacted with plant roots. Measured weekly
attribute_information.RFresh_Weight: Fresh weight of the roots after harvest
attribute_information.Root_Length: Length of the roots after harvest
attribute_information.Row-Column: Row (if NFT) or column (if vertical) in each compartment
attribute_information.Stomata_Conduct: Stomata conductance of the largest leaf on each plant. Measured twice a week
attribute_information.Treatment: Treatment applied to the nutrient solution in the compartment
attribute_information.Width: Width of lettuce plants. Measured twice a week

meta.description: Enriching the concentration of CO2 dissolved in nutrient solution used to grow lettuce in both vertical and NFT systems. CO2 enrichment levels were no enrichment, 50mg/L and 100mg/L. Growth parameters during and after harvest were measured.
meta.name: CO2 Enriched Irrigation
